Takeaway:
God’s grace frees us to live from acceptance rather than for acceptance.

Division 1 — The Need for Grace in the Old Testament

Principle:
Even at our best, we stand guilty before a holy God.

3-Minute Application Question:
When you know you’ve done something wrong, are you most likely to
(a) make excuses,
(b) try harder, or
(c) admit your need for grace? ) 

Why?



Division 2 — The Gift of Grace in Romans

Principle:
Christ took our guilt so we can be accepted before God.

3-Minute Application Question:
What makes it hard to believe that Christ is enough for God to accept you?



Division 3 — The Life of Grace in Paul

Principle:
Grace frees us to live from God’s acceptance.

3-Minute Application Question:
Where in your life are you still trying to prove yourself instead of living from God’s acceptance?
